chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Seek refuge with Allah from the burden of debt, the dominance of men, and the ruin of the unmarried.

key_terms.بَوَارِ الْأَيِّمِ: the ruin or loss associated with remaining unmarried
key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: through Allah and by turning to Him for protection
key_terms.غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ: the overpowering burden and pressure of debt
key_terms.غَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ: the domination or overpowering of people over a person

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teach to seek refuge from regarding debt and social hardship?
ai.summary: Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructs believers to seek refuge in Allah from harmful worldly conditions that bring hardship and vulnerability. The narration highlights debt, subjugation by others, and the ruinous condition of remaining unmarried as matters for which one should turn to Allah in protection.
